description: Join Dan Hutnik and Daryl Obert as they walk through what MegaLights is, how it works, and how to set it up, along with best practices for lighting with MegaLights and the tips and tricks they use to get the most out of it in their projects. Whether you're already familiar with lighting in UE5 or just getting started, they'll cover everything you need to know to incorporate MegaLights into your workflows and get the most out of its capabilities.
title: Artist's Guide to Using MegaLights in Unreal Engine 5.8 | Inside Unreal
